reviews.text: Great job.  Love the customer service.
My dog is usually very afraid of groomers but she always leaves here happy and looking super cute!!

Always love coming here. My cousin recommend because they do amazing with her two dogs. My girls came out so nice and then went again for Halloween time for a color job. Best groomer I've even gone to.

I love the team at So Fetch, I am so grateful for their care and patience for my 14 year old elderly dog Snoopy!! I've been bringing Snoopy to them since 2020!! They are great, I'm so happy with them and Snoopy and I feel so at ease whenever I schedule a grooming appointment there. Thank you So Fetch team!!

I love this place! The ladies are always nice and take care of my dog. I have a medium size bichon and he needs constant hair care. They always do great cuts he comes back fab and his nails get trimmed also. They always do a great job and it is reasonably priced. I will continue to bring my dog here it's clean and my dog always enjoys the other dogs company.
Took Kiki in for a bath and haircut. The service was excellent—Kiki came back smelling wonderful! Highly recommended.

I always book for a sm dog full groom and So fetch does a great job. She always comes back smelling good, cute accessories & they do it based on the holiday or season, and her cut is always perfect. Only problem is my dog is there for 4 hours every time and that’s unacceptable. I understand it’s a small business but if my appointment time is at 12, I should definitely have my dog by 2. I hate dropping my dog off knowing that she’s gonna sit there for 2-3 hours until they get to her & then another hour to actually service her. They do great work but service & wait times is unfair to my dog & my time.

I’ve been meaning to leave a review for So Fetch! and can’t recommend them enough to anyone looking for a reliable, caring dog groomer. I’ve tried several places, and this one has consistently been my top choice.

The team is incredibly attentive and takes great care of your dog from the bath and nail trim to the haircut. They’re gentle, patient, and clearly treat every pet like their own (honestly, it makes me wish I could get my haircut there too 😄).

They do operate by appointment, so be sure to call ahead to schedule. The process is simple: drop your dog off and they’ll give you a call when your pup is ready. They’re also great at following your preferences just show them a picture, and they’ll deliver exactly what you’re looking for.

My dog Bambino always comes back looking super handsome and smelling amazing. If you’re searching for a groomer you can trust, look no further book your appointment!
So grateful I found them. I brought my senior husky for a bath and they were so loving and patient with him. Very reasonable prices. Definitely recommend!
She is so wonderful with my dogs, so caring and gentle

I have to say that for my first visit and overall experience, it wasn't the best. The appointment was at 12:00, and according to the schedule, the service would take between 12:00 and 12:30, at least that's what I understood. Once I arrived, the lady politely told me to come back in 2 to 3 hours. I waited the 3 hours, and when I asked how much longer, she said one more hour, but that wasn't the case; they took another 30 minutes! The haircut wasn't the best. I don't think I'll be back.
Took in my five month old cat Pete today and the workers were lovely they were gentle and swift. Amazing experience will totally be coming here from now on!! They are also very affordable!!
Wonderful customer service and splendid dog care.
They’re super attentive and patient with my dog!
It was awesome!!!!,
I don’t even have to say anything. They eat everytime.

Torn to give this place only 3 stars because they always give my dog great haircuts and leave her smelling beautifully. The owners are also very nice but unfortunately have to deduct 2 stars because it’s been many times that I take my dog in for grooming and they have her there for up to 5 or 6 hours. For some reason they always leave my pup till last, i’m not sure why. Whether I take her early in the morning or in the afternoon, her pick up time is always late.

Today in particular I asked for just a bath and a trim, dropped her at 2 pm and was told to pick her up at 5 pm. I get a call at 5 stating they were behind and won’t be done till closer to 6 but most likely before. Ok, i understand. I called at 6 and now they said she won’t be done till 7. I show up at 7 and I wait about another 20 minutes because she wasn’t done yet & they still had to groom her legs and head. I let them finish grooming my pup’s legs but asked to take her as is without grooming the head because I had somewhere to be this evening. Regardless, a business shouldn’t overbook themselves, and why was every other dog given priority and mine last again? It’s a bummer, I don’t appreciate my dog being in a crate for long hours and still being last to be done.

The owner did offer finishing her and dropping her off at my house when done or coming back to finish another day, however these options don’t work for me. I make time to bring my dog to get groomed and she was there for 5+ hours and still not done? This shouldn’t inconvenience me in having to come back in to finish a grooming service that should’ve been completed during her appointment.

Sadly, I won’t be returning. I understand this happening once or twice but many times I bring her in she’s in there for long hours and last one to get finished.
Very friendly place
They gave my dog a great service. Nails trimmed, hair cut and washed was all included. Very pleased and will return again soon.
Third time patronizing this business and they were fantastic as usual. They do exactly what you ask and they don’t rush your baby’s service. I also like that she doesnt overcharge !!
Fair pricing. Great service. Friendly owners! Support local business owners!
I love them they keep my babies looking pretty smelling good and clean 🧼 ❤️😘 …
Great service. They always do a good job with the grooming. My dog comes out looking super cute!!
These people are freaking amazing🥰🥰Alex I think her name is was a huge blessing. I would recommend them to anyone. They are the best …
Very professional, very kind. Excellent service!!!!!!
Great customer service kind and gentle with your pet and great prices
Love her work. However don't schedule appointments  if you're not available ar that time... Over book
Oh I love this place…they had my fur baby sooooo cute and pretty and she smelled good too. Very reasonable in price…I’ll definitely be back ♥️
